'''Marcelo Osvaldo Magnasco''' is a biophysicist and a professor at [[Rockefeller University]].

== Career ==
He is known for his work on [[thermal ratchet]]s as models of biological motors,<ref>{{citation
|title=Making Models of Muscle Contraction
|first1=John
|last1=Maddox
|journal=Nature
|date=Sep 16, 1993
|volume=365
|issue=6443
|pages=203
|doi=10.1038/365203a0
|pmid=8371773
|bibcode=1993Natur.365..203M
|s2cid=5602010
}}</ref> [[Auditory system|auditory]] [[biophysics]],<ref>{{citation
|title=Canaries Change Their Tune
|journal=Nature News
|first1=Phillip
|date=Nov 2, 2001
|last1=Ball
|doi=10.1038/news011108-2
}}</ref><ref>{{citation
|title=What's shaking in the ear?
|last1=Cho
|first1=Adrian
|journal=Science
|volume=288
|pages=1954–1955 
|date=Jun 16, 2000
|issue=5473
|doi=10.1126/science.288.5473.1954
|pmid=10877709
|s2cid=118174911
}}</ref> [[bailout embedding]]s,<ref>[[Julyan Cartwright|Julyan H. E. Cartwright]], Marcelo O. Magnasco, and Oreste Piro "Bailout embeddings, targeting of invariant tori, and the control of Hamiltonian chaos", Phys. Rev. E 65, 045203(R) (2002).</ref> [[neural coding]],<ref>{{citation
|title=Complexity Digest 2000.19
|url=http://comdig.unam.mx/index.php?id_issue=2000.19
|publisher=Complexity Digest
|date=Feb 19, 2001
}}</ref> other studies of [[network biology|biological networks]] such as [[leaf#Venation|leaf venation]],<ref>{{citation
 |url         = http://www.sciencefriday.com/videos/watch/10277
 |title       = Lighting Up Leaves
 |first1      = Flora
 |last1       = Lichtman
 |publisher   = Science Friday
 |date        = Feb 19, 2010
 |url-status     = dead
 |archiveurl  = https://web.archive.org/web/20110928090122/http://www.sciencefriday.com/videos/watch/10277
 |archivedate = 2011-09-28
}}</ref> and for placing the date of the [[solar eclipse]] mentioned in the [[Odyssey]] on April 16, 1178 B.C.<ref>{{citation
   |title=Is an eclipse described in the Odyssey?
   |first1=Constantino
   |last1= Baikouzis
   |first2=Marcelo O.
   |last2= Magnasco
   |date=June 24, 2008
   |doi=10.1073/pnas.0803317105
   |journal=Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
   |volume=105
   |issue=26
 |pages=8823–8828
|pmid=18577587
|pmc=2440358
|doi-access=free
 }}</ref> together with Constantino Baikouzis of the [[National University of La Plata]].<ref>{{citation
   |url=http://www.lanacion.com.ar/nota.asp?nota_id=1024227
   |title=Hallan precisiones astronómicas en la poesía de Homero]
   |first1=Nora
   |last1=Bär
   |publisher=Edicion, Diario La Nacion
   |date=July 1, 2008
   |doi=
   |accessdate=2008-01-07
   |journal=Diario la Nacion
   |volume=
   |pages=
}}</ref><ref>{{citation
|first1=JR
|last1=Minkel
|journal=Scientific American (News)
|date=Jun 23, 2008
|title=Homer's Odyssey Said to Document 3,200-Year-Old Eclipse
|url=http://www.scientificamerican.com/article.cfm?id=homers-odyssey-may-document-eclipse
}}</ref>

In 2013, Magnasco formed the m<sup>2</sup>c<sup>2</sup> collaboration with [[cetacean]] researcher [[Diana Reiss]] in order to study marine mammal communication and cognition.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.m2c2.net/latexm2c2latex/marcelo-magnasco/marcelo-magnasco/|title=Marcelo Magnasco – m2c2|language=en-US|access-date=2019-08-14}}</ref><ref>{{citation
|title=Marine Mammal Communication and Cognition Laboratory Website
|url=http://www.m2c2.net
}}</ref> Their interdisciplinary team is probing [[dolphin intelligence]] using an underwater interactive touchpad at the [[National Aquarium (Baltimore)]].<ref>{{citation
|date=May 25, 2017
|title=Scientists to probe dolphin intelligence using an interactive touchpad
|url=http://www.m2c2.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Official-Press-Release.pdf
}}</ref>
